Senses.Explanation: The overcompensating second half of a denial proverb: protesting that there is no silver here prompts conspicuous wine-buying that exposes the matter. Xutang Zhiyu uses the expression through direct paired deployment reversing the order of denial and wine purchase. Qingshan Pufu Zhuo independently deploys it through independent criticism of dream-talk through the complete proverb.
